bibl.title: PL III/1039: fragment de psautier bilingue grec-copte.
bibl.seg: Alain Delattre & Anna Di Giglio, PL III/1039: fragment de psautier bilingue grec-copte.
bibl.note: Bilingual codex in Greek and Coptic, which contains some verses of Psalms 97 and 98, 2nd half of the Vth c. The fragment belongs probably to an already known bilingual psalter from Antinoupolis, P. Ant. Inv. 26.01.06 (= CLM 1188; LDAB 113257).
